subject: GSM Phone Maintenance and Repairs
sourceFile: Technical & Trade -- GSM PHONES MAINTENANCE AND REPAIRS.txt
examFormat: Two papers taken as a composite paper at one sitting. Paper 1: 40 multiple choice objective questions in 45 minutes for 40 marks. Paper 2 (1 3/4 hours, 100 marks): Section A has twelve essay questions of which any ten are answered in 55 minutes for 60 marks; Section B has two practical-work questions, both answered in 50 minutes for 40 marks.
excluded: Supervised apprenticeship requirement (eight weeks) and the list of minimum equipment, as non-topic material.

topics.name: Introduction to Mobile Phones and Service Providers

subtopics.name: Mobile Phone Acronyms and Terminologies
objectives: Define mobile phones and their terminologies, including GSM, CDMA, mobile phones/cell phones/user equipment, MMS, SMS, call barring, call forwarding, BSI, DCT, FPS

subtopics.name: Mobile Phone Bands and Their Uses
objectives: Describe single, double, tri and quad bands and their uses

subtopics.name: Types of Mobile Phones
objectives: Identify mobile phone types (straight, flip, slides etc.) and their special maintenance needs

subtopics.name: Phone Accessories and Their Functions
objectives: Identify phone accessories (headsets/hands free, earpiece, external Bluetooth, batteries, chargers, cables etc.) and state their functions

subtopics.name: Types of Menus and Sub-menus
objectives: Describe menus and sub-menus (phone book, message, call, settings, applications etc.) and their functions

subtopics.name: Service Providers and Their Codes
objectives: Identify major voice service providers and their service codes

subtopics.name: Introduction to Computer
objectives: Define, identify and state the functions of computer hardware (monitor, CPU, keyboard etc.) and software (operating and application) components

subtopics.name: Introduction to Internet
objectives: Describe web access platforms including WAP, GPRS, EDGE, Wi-Fi and 3G

subtopics.name: Browsing the Web
objectives: Carry out browsing activities such as downloading and uploading

topics.name: Essential Components of Mobile Phones and Their Functions

subtopics.name: Structure of Mobile Phones
objectives: Draw the basic block diagram (power unit, memory unit and radio unit) and state the function of each block

subtopics.name: Hardware Components
objectives: Identify, describe and state the functions of hardware components including CPU, SIM socket, earpiece, keypad, buzzer and vibrator

subtopics.name: Software Components
objectives: Describe the operating and application software components of mobile phones

topics.name: Maintenance and Repair of Mobile Phones

subtopics.name: Electronic Components in Mobile Phones
objectives: Identify resistors, capacitors, diodes, transistors, ICs etc. in mobile phones

subtopics.name: Preventive Maintenance
objectives: Define preventive maintenance and state its functions, reasons, advantages and procedures (cleaning, soldering, de-soldering, re-balling etc.)

subtopics.name: Corrective Maintenance
objectives: Define corrective maintenance and state its functions, reasons, advantages and procedures (cleaning, soldering, de-soldering, re-balling etc.)

subtopics.name: Common Tools and Equipment for Hardware and Software Repairs
objectives: Identify common tools and equipment for hardware repairs (star, Allen key, lead, precision set, multi-meter, oscilloscope, computer set, soldering iron and sucker etc.) and state their uses
Identify common software tools for repair such as unlocking software, flashing software and firmware installation

subtopics.name: Safety in Mobile Phone Workshop
objectives: List safety rules and regulations
Use maintenance tools safely
Identify basic safety facilities in the workshop (first aid box, fire extinguishers etc.)

subtopics.name: Common Hardware Problems
objectives: Identify hardware problems such as damaged screen, charging ports, mouthpiece, earpiece and keyboard

subtopics.name: Common Software Problems
objectives: Identify software problems such as 'contact service provider', 'phone lock code', 'invalid SIM' and 'SIM card rejected'

subtopics.name: Basic Trouble-shooting
objectives: Disassemble, assemble, test and trouble-shoot components such as displays, speakers, vibrators, ringers, charging ports, charging jacks, batteries, keypads and panels
Trouble-shoot/fault find using relevant mobile phone menus
Identify mobile phone ICs and electronic components
Read PCB circuit layouts and schematic diagrams

subtopics.name: Tracing and Fault Finding in Hardware
objectives: Identify faulty components using visuals, continuity test, open circuit and short circuit tests
Test voltages on PCB (voltage levels at various points and voltage specification of IC pins)
Apply trouble-shooting techniques: metering methods, signal tracing/injection, component testing, visual inspections
Trouble-shoot Surface Mount Devices (SMD) and Ball Grid Array (BGA)

subtopics.name: Fault Finding in Software
objectives: Use software codes for fault finding
Find faults related to software (SIM locked, SIM rejected, hanging problem, restart problem etc.)
Flash mobile phones using flashing devices and software and state their uses
Carry out phone lock/security unlocking and resetting counters

topics.name: Setting up and Managing Mobile Phone Workshop

subtopics.name: Setting up a Mobile Phone Workshop
objectives: State the capital, personnel and factors determining choice of location

subtopics.name: Facilities and Equipment for Mobile Phone Workshop
objectives: Identify appropriate facilities/equipment for a mobile phone workshop

subtopics.name: Managing a Mobile Phone Business
objectives: Carry out risk analyses, costing and return on investment
